facts: Parties: Penrith Energy plc (Buyer), Ingleby Engineering Ltd (Seller); the Company is Holloway Robotics Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 28 August 2026; Closing is scheduled for 24 November 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 2 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $3,000,000.

Section 8.4 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $5,400,000. The Purchase Price is $45,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 4.5: if the Conditions are not satisfied by the date falling 120 days after the date of this Agreement (signed 28 August 2026), either party may terminate.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $6,100,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,900,000.
Regulatory counsel expects merger clearance by 9 January 2027.
Item 5: the board noted a letter before action from Foxley Foods Ltd threatening proceedings for approximately $2,750,000 in respect of alleged defective deliveries. Management to monitor.
